PolyCup

By Kiki · Simple Cup for PolyTrack 0.6.3

Join, choose one track, and race together. Any 2–8 racers can start. Reach 140 points, then win a later round to win the Cup.

  • No seeding, captain draft, semifinals or full-grid requirement.
  • Each racer picks one official, community or locally saved custom track. Shared picks count once; the order is shuffled.
  • Automatic rounds and WR-based track rotation: about four minutes of driving per track, with four rounds when no WR is available.
  • Lobby invite code and Copy button available on every PolyCup tab.
  • Native slanted panels, italic game typography, integrated toolbar access and a leaderboard that moves with the native UI.
  • Clear race standings, green point gains, finalist markers and car-skin previews.
  • G hides other racers' ghosts. Rebind it in the game's Settings under PolyCup.
  • Overall WR, scored Cup session record (TR), and the watched racer’s overall PB.
  • Switchable racer POV with a 250 ms camera and car buffer.
  • First-visit practice based on the WR, with Ready controls to start early.
  • Automatically watch remaining racers after finishing or retiring; toggle it in regular settings.
  • Winner presentation, final standings, quick rematches and shareable results images.
  • Organizer controls for DNF, void, undo, reconnect and results export.

Open PolyCup from the native in-game toolbar, or press F8. Everyone needs version 0.2.9. The organizer stays connected; no separate tournament server is required. Native room capacity includes spectators.

PBs are reported by players’ mods; records need the game’s own profile or leaderboard service. New save format; older bracket saves cannot resume in Simple Cup. See the repository README for validation and limits.

Independent community mod. Not affiliated with Kodub, Trackmania, Ubisoft or PolyModLoader.
